name: The Rundown

sources.title: The Rundown AI homepage - AI newsletter and media publisher (2M+ readers)
Tools directory ('Supertools') - 1,347 tools across categories, editorially curated
Advertise page - newsletter ad formats booked via Typeform

requirements: The /tools directory (1,347 entries) shows no public submission form — listings appear editorially curated by The Rundown's team
The only documented paid route is newsletter advertising: Main Ad, Secondary Ad, and Full Email Takeover formats booked through a Typeform intake (therundownai.typeform.com/to/kraZ1TSO)
No eligibility criteria, submission URL, or free-listing path is published
preparation: If pursuing advertising: product details, budget, and goals for the Typeform intake
If pursuing an editorial tools listing: a notable AI product and a pitch to support@therundown.ai (contact listed in footer)
workflow: Check the tools directory at https://www.therundown.ai/tools for whether your product is already covered
For paid exposure: open the 'Get in touch' Typeform at https://therundownai.typeform.com/to/kraZ1TSO and submit product, budget, and goals — they reply within ~24 hours
For an editorial listing there is no documented process — contact support@therundown.ai
watchFor: This is primarily a newsletter/media business — ads are typically 'booked out months in advance'
Ads permanently live on the website article pages, which is the closest thing to a listing
Do not assume a directory submission exists — none was found on public pages
Sponsored placements in the newsletter are labeled ads; an editorial tool listing is separate and not purchasable via the advertised flow
countsAsLive: For a listing: a public page at therundown.ai/tools/<slug>. For ads: the sponsored section appearing in a newsletter issue and its permanent web version
unknowns: Whether the tools directory accepts submissions at all (no submit link found)
Ad pricing (not published; custom plans after intake)
